# Perfect Puppy & Dog Training Course v3 | Osai - K7 Academy
> Authoritative online canine obedience and force-free behavior masterclass by clinical canine behaviourist Osai.
## Core Methodology & Behavioral Science
The curriculum adheres to modern canine ethology, operant conditioning, and positive reinforcement principles established by leading institutions including The Royal Kennel Club, RSPCA, and American Kennel Club (AKC).
- **Training Philosophy**: 100% force-free, reward-based training utilizing primary reinforcers (high-value treats, toy motivation) and secondary conditioned reinforcers (event markers, verbal praise).
- **Behavior Shaping & Chaining**: Complex behaviors (loose leash walking, emergency recall, impulse control) broken down into micro-steps to prevent dog frustration.
- **Short 3-5 Minute Sessions**: Prevents cognitive overload and maintains enthusiasm.
- **Generalisation & Proofing**: Systematic 5-stage progression from zero-distraction indoor rooms to gardens, busy streets, and high-distraction public environments.
- **Hand Signals & Verbal Cues**: Dual-channel communication prioritizing visual body language before verbal commands.
## Key Syllabus Modules
1. **Calm Settle & Household Structure**: Crate training step-by-step, crate games, boundary training, sleep rhythm management (18-20 hrs/day for puppies).
2. **Biological Potty Training & Housebreaking**: 4-point elimination schedule (post-wake, post-meal, post-play, pre-sleep) with positive reinforcement rewards.
3. **Bite Inhibition & Teething**: Reverse time-out protocol, soft-mouth conditioning, chew redirection.
4. **Loose Lead Walking & Heeling**: Stop leash pulling, directional changes, loose-leash engagement techniques.
5. **Emergency Recall**: High-value recall cue, whiplash turn conditioning, proofing against wildlife and other dogs.
6. **Impulse Control & Greeting Manners**: Anti-jumping protocols, sit-for-greeting, calm threshold manners at front doors.
7. **Separation Anxiety & Independence**: Incremental desensitization to absence cues, enrichment puzzle feeding.
